title: Opposite of a triangulated functor
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be pre-triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] and let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ have coherent integer-shift comparisons and carry distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles. Equip each opposite category with the opposite pre-triangulated structure: its shift by $n$ is the opposite of the original shift by $-n$, and its distinguished triangles are the reversals $\operatorname{op}Z\to\operatorname{op}Y\to\operatorname{op}X\to(\operatorname{op}Z)[1]$ of distinguished triangles $X\to Y\to Z\to X[1]$, with the last arrow induced by shifting the original third arrow by $-1$. Then $F^{\mathrm{op}}:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}}$ has coherent integer-shift comparisons and is triangulated.
